newsitem.title: USA: Sprint, Telmex form U.S. marketing venture.
newsitem.headline: Sprint, Telmex form U.S. marketing venture.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) and Sprint Corp. said Friday they formed a joint venture to market long-distance service to Hispanic markets in the United States.
The 50-50 venture will offer conveniently packaged calling plans and products for both Hispanic homes and businesses, taking advantage of Telmex's Hispanic marketing expertise, the companies said.
The joint venture builds on an alliance agreement signed by Sprint and Telmex in April 1995. The name of the new company is expected to be announced in the coming weeks.

Telmex, which operates the largest local and long distance network in Mexico with more than 19,000 miles of fiber optic cable, said it has made significant investment in interconnection arrangements with U.S. companies now competing in the Mexican market.
Sprint is a global communications company, operating an all-digital, fiber-optic network in the United States.
Sprint's stock rose 62.5 cents to $45.25, while Telmex fell 25 cents to $38.625 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
